fields.before: 스스로를 몰아붙이는 방법은 두 가지입니다. 해내면 상금을 받는 방식이 있습니다. 보증금을 걸고 해내면 돌려받는 방식도 있습니다. 두 방식 모두에 동의한 사람은 보증금형에서 더 많이 해냈습니다. 차이는 13퍼센트포인트였습니다. 보증금형에 동의한 사람은 13.7%뿐이었습니다. 반면 상금형에는 90%가 동의했습니다. 보증금은 돈을 걸 의향이 있는 사람에게만 효과가 있습니다.
fields.after: 금연에서는 상금형의 6개월 금연 유지율이 15.7%였습니다. 보증금형은 10.2%였습니다. 실패하면 보증금을 잃으니 걸 의향부터 확인하세요. 논문 쓰기나 운동에도 같을지는 모릅니다.

evidencequotes: Of those assigned to reward-based programs, 90.0% accepted the assignment, as compared with 13.7% of those assigned to deposit-based programs (P<0.001).

In intention-to-treat analyses, rates of sustained abstinence from smoking through 6 months were higher with each of the four incentive programs (range, 9.4 to 16.0%) than with usual care (6.0%) (P<0.05 for all comparisons); the superiority of reward-based programs was sustained through 12 months.
Reward-based programs were associated with higher abstinence rates than deposit-based programs (15.7% vs. 10.2%, P<0.001).

However, in instrumental-variable analyses that accounted for differential acceptance, the rate of abstinence at 6 months was 13.2 percentage points (95% confidence interval, 3.1 to 22.8) higher in the deposit-based programs than in the reward-based programs among the estimated 13.7% of the participants who would accept participation in either type of program.
